# Diffusion {#sec-ch08}

This chapter describes the vertical eddy-diffusion operator of kintera. It moves each species up or down a column
so that its mixing ratio evens out, at a rate set by an eddy diffusion coefficient on the faces between levels.
The operator returns a tendency; it does not take a time step. Two functions carry it: one builds the three
coefficients of each level, and one applies them to the species profiles. Molecular diffusion is not part of this
code; it lives in the two-dimensional solver of @sec-ch09.

The dependency map of the two schemes (a figure) is not drawn yet: the tendency of @sec-ch08-tendency uses the
coefficients of @sec-ch08-operator and nothing else.

| scheme | option | default | main test |
|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch08-operator | `diffusion_coefficients` | always | `test_diffusion` |
| @sec-ch08-tendency | `diffusion_tendency` | always | `test_diffusion`, `test_atm2d.py` |
